fallback.lovedLine: {npc} turns the {item} over once and then puts it somewhere safe rather than somewhere convenient. "Thank you. Genuinely."
fallback.likedLine: {npc} weighs the {item} and nods slowly. "That is a good thing to be given. I will not forget who gave it."
fallback.politeLine: {npc} takes the {item} with good grace. It goes under the counter, and you suspect it stays there.
fallback.insultLine: {npc} looks at the {item}, and then at you, for slightly too long. "No. You keep that."

irma_ironhand.lovedLine: Irma stops mid-swing. She takes the {item}, turns it to the light, and makes a small sound she would deny making. "Where. Where did you get this." She does not wait for an answer. "No. Do not tell me. Thank you."
irma_ironhand.likedLine: Irma takes the {item} without ceremony and puts it in the good rack — the one at the back. From her, that is a speech.
irma_ironhand.politeLine: Irma accepts the {item}, looks at it, and sets it down on the bench where things go to be forgotten. "Kind of you."
irma_ironhand.insultLine: Irma does not take her hand off the hammer. "I have a forge, a rack of plate, and forty years. And you have brought me that."

halem_trader.lovedLine: Halem's whole face changes. "Oh, now that is lovely." He turns the {item} over twice. "I am not going to sell this. I want you to know that I thought about it and I am not going to."
halem_trader.likedLine: "Well now." Halem takes the {item} and finds it a spot on the shelf where he can see it from the counter. "That was not necessary. Which is rather the point of it."
halem_trader.politeLine: Halem takes the {item} with the professional warmth of a man who has been given a great many things. "Very good. Very good."
halem_trader.insultLine: Halem's cheer holds, barely. "I trade in a lot of poor goods, friend. I do not accept them as presents."

scrap_broker.lovedLine: Tellin goes quiet. He turns the {item} slowly, finds the join, and stops. "This is not from here." A long pause. "I will not ask. But I will remember that it was you who put it in my hand."
scrap_broker.likedLine: Tellin weighs the {item} and writes something down, which from him is the highest form of respect. "Onto the short shelf."
scrap_broker.politeLine: Tellin takes the {item} and prices it out of habit before catching himself. "Sorry. Force of the trade. Thank you."
scrap_broker.insultLine: "I know what that is worth," Tellin says. "To the quarter-weight. Do not do that to me."

odar_flameforge.lovedLine: Odar feeds the {item} nothing, holds it near the flame, and watches the light move on it. "It answers," he says, and that is apparently the highest praise available.
odar_flameforge.likedLine: Odar takes the {item} and sets it by the forge, which is where he puts things he intends to keep.
odar_flameforge.politeLine: Odar accepts the {item}. It does not go near the fire, which tells you what he thinks of it.
odar_flameforge.insultLine: Odar looks at the {item}, then at the forge, then back. "That would not even burn well."

yara_windcaller.lovedLine: Yara holds the {item} up and lets the air take it, and listens to what it does. "It does not fight," she says, delighted. "Do you know how rare that is?"
yara_windcaller.likedLine: Yara folds the {item} into the cloth pile and touches it once more than she needs to.
yara_windcaller.politeLine: Yara takes the {item} and finds it a hook. "It will be useful to somebody."
yara_windcaller.insultLine: "It will not move," Yara says of the {item}, as though that settles it. It does.

bran_the_beastmaster.lovedLine: Bran takes the {item} and immediately gives half of it to the dog, which he clearly considers the correct handling of a gift. "She thanks you. I thank you."
bran_the_beastmaster.likedLine: Bran turns the {item} over. "Good. That will go a long way out where I am."
bran_the_beastmaster.politeLine: Bran accepts the {item} and puts it in the pile of things that will eventually be traded to somebody who wants them.
bran_the_beastmaster.insultLine: Bran looks at the {item} and then at the dog, who has more sense. "No, lad. No."

order_scholar.lovedLine: Vesryn does not touch the {item} immediately. They clear a space first, and lay a cloth, and only then take it. "Do you understand what you have handed me? No. That is all right. I do."
order_scholar.likedLine: Vesryn accepts the {item} and, unusually, does not begin cataloguing it in front of you. "Later. When I can give it attention."
order_scholar.politeLine: Vesryn takes the {item} with the courtesy of somebody who receives a great deal of well-meant rubbish. "Thank you."
order_scholar.insultLine: "I am an archivist," Vesryn says, not unkindly. "You have brought me an object with no provenance, no age and no interest. Take it back."

tarek_tinkerer.lovedLine: Tarek makes a noise like a man who has been handed his own childhood. "Where — no. NO. Do you know how long I have —" He stops, composes himself, fails. "Thank you. Go away. I need to look at this."
tarek_tinkerer.likedLine: Tarek takes the {item} apart before he has finished thanking you, which is his way of accepting it.
tarek_tinkerer.politeLine: Tarek accepts the {item} and sets it on the bench with the other things that are not urgent.
tarek_tinkerer.insultLine: Tarek turns the {item} once. "There is nothing inside it," he says, sadly. "Not everything has to be a mechanism, but I would rather you kept it."

revivalists_quartermaster.lovedLine: Sister Yune takes the {item} in both hands. "Do you know what this is, in a store like ours? It is four days. Four days of somebody not being frightened." She looks up. "Thank you."
revivalists_quartermaster.likedLine: Yune adds the {item} to the store and marks it in the book. "It goes where it is needed, not where it is asked for. I hope that is all right."
revivalists_quartermaster.politeLine: Yune accepts the {item} warmly and finds it a shelf. "Everything has a use eventually."
revivalists_quartermaster.insultLine: Yune's kindness does not falter, which makes it worse. "We would rather have nothing than be given nothing dressed up as something."
